articles.title: Up to 580tps! New Speed Record of Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on GPU for Agentic Workloads with TokenSpeed
articles.summary: TL;DR: The TokenSpeed inference engine achieved a record-breaking 580 tps running the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B model on GPUs. This extreme performance for agentic workloads is driven by systematic elimination of memory copies,...
articles.why: Eliminates memory copies to achieve high token throughput on large Mixture-of-Experts models during agentic workloads.

articles.title: Two Chips, One Decade, One Winner
articles.summary: Two hyperscalers bet on custom AI silicon a decade ago. One built a chip that its own models run on. The other is buying the demand, renting the hardware, and booking the difference as profit.
articles.why: Compares custom ASIC strategies versus merchant silicon profitability across hyperscalers.
